s: Dine lulab ubo k"a seipim: "uleqachtem lakem bayyom harishon peri etz hadar kappot temarim vaanap etz abot vearbe nachal vego'", vedareshu chakamim "peri etz" — shehaetz kepiryo betaam shaveh, veezeh? Zeh etrog shettaam etzo upiryo shaveh:

"Hadar" — sheyyihyeh naeh, ve"hadar" betooro ubegiddulo, veal derek sheyyitbaer besiman trm"ch. Ulepi shekkol arbaa minim ellu ketubim bepasuq echad — hare huqqeshu zeh lazeh ulemedin zeh mizzeh, lepikak kol d' minim ellu tzerikim lihyot naim umehuddarim betooram ubegiddulam, veal derek sheyyitbaer:

"Kappot temarim" — zeh lulab shehu gadel al ilan shel temarim, umittok shekkotba hattora leshon "kappot" velo kotba "ale temarim", mikkan atta lamed shetztzarik sheyyihyeh otan alim hareuyin leogdan velikpotan im hashshidra mechamat shehen adayin rakkim, shehare lo niktebu nequddot battora, uperusho hu "kaput". Abal im shaha hallulab al haddeqel ad shennitqashshu alayv keetz venitrachaqu venitparedu mehashshidra, shekken hu darkan, shekkol mah shehen mosipim lehitqashshot hen mitrachaqim mehashshidra, veim nitqashshu kol kak ad shei epshar likpotan uleogdan im hashshidra — hare zeh pasul:

Abal im lo nitqashshu kol kak, ap al pi shekkol zeman sheenan keputin hen omedin meporadin umeruchaqin zeh mizzeh — ap al pi ken hu kasher apillu im lo kapetu kelal, shello hiqpida tora ella sheyyehe rauy likpotah abal lo sheyyehe kaput mammash, shehare en anu qorin "kaput" ella "kappot":

Umikkol maqom, mitzva min hammubchar shello littol lulab shealayv perudot zeh mizzeh apillu im lo nitqashshu kelal, ella shemmechamat shenneeqru meat bimqom chibburam bashshidra nitparedu zeh mizzeh meat, ap al pi sheen teluyin lematta kelal ella hen olin lemala im hashshidra:

Abal im hen teluyin veenan olin im hashshidra ella im ken ogedin otan immo — hare lulab zeh pasul min hattora, apillu im lo neeqru healim legamre mehashshidra ella hen mechubbarim immo meat, vaapillu agad otan im hashshidra — en zeh hiddur:

Pesulim hallalu shebbealin shebbearnu — enan poselin ella im ken hen rob healin shel hallulab, abal im miut healin naasu kak verob healin nisharu mechubbarin bashshidra umekassin et rob hashshidra veal derek sheyyitbaer — hare zeh kasher, lepi shehakkol holek achar harob:

Im hashshidra atzmah nishbera beemtzaitah, velo nishbera legamre lishne chalaqim ella nitqappela lishnayim shecheleq haelyon taluy lematta — kasher, umikkol maqom tzarik leogdo sham bimqom haqqepel shello yihyeh rosho taluy lematta:

Derek beriyyat healin shel lulab kak hi, keshehen gedelim — gedelim shenayim shenayim, zeh leummat zeh mishshene tzidde hashshidra, vekol aleh vealeh kapul lishnayim, vehu dabuq miggabbo upatuach millepanayv, veim nechlequ rob healin shel hallulab lishnayim berob orkan, dehaynu sherob ale hallulab nisdequ miggabban bimqom haqqepel, beinyan shekkol aleh mehen nechlaq berob orko lishnayim — hare lulab zeh pasul, lepi sheeno mehuddar. Veken im mittechillat beriyyato lo hayu rob alayv kepulim lishnayim berob orkan — hare zeh pasul:

Vekol zeh bishar ale hallulab chutz mealeh haelyon haemtzai, abal aleh haelyon haemtzai shehu gaboah mikkol healin, vehu niqra rosh hallulab, vederek aleh zeh lihyot kapul kishar ale hallulab, veim lo haya kapul mittechillat beriyyato — hare zeh pasul, apillu im kol healin chutz mizzeh hen kepulin. Veken im haya kapul mittechillat beriyyato veachar kak nechlaq lishnayim bekol orko, dehaynu merosho ad maqom shealin yotzein mishsham (shemmimmaqom zeh ulematta eno niqra aleh haemtzai ella gup hashshidra) — pasul. Upesulim ellu shebbealeh haelyon eno mishshum hiddur hallulab, ella mishshum shenneemar "uleqachtem", vedareshu chakamim leqicha tamma ushelema, vezeh healeh shehu iqqar hallulab shehaadam roeh oto bitchillat hashqapato, vedarko lihyot kapul bekol hallulabin, veim hu chaluq lishnayim — hare nikkar venireh sheeno tam veshalem bimqom hassedeq:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Benechlaq bekol orko, abal im lo nechlaq ella miqtzato — kasher. Vekol zeh bediabad, o sheen lo lulab acher — eno tzarik lebarek al lulab shel chabero beyom a' shel sukkot, abal lekattechilla mitzva min hammubchar lechazzer achar lulab shello nechlaq aleh haelyon shello kelal ella hu kapul merosho ad maqom shealin yotzein mishsham, lepi sheyyesh poselin apillu im lo nechlaq ella miqtzat aleh zeh haelyon, veap al pi sheen halaka kedibrehem, mikkol maqom tob lachosh ledibrehem im epshar:

Veim nisdeqa hashshidra tachat aleh zeh haelyon, dehaynu mimmaqom shealeha yotzeim ulematta, im nitrachaqu shene tzidde hassedeq zeh mizzeh ad sheyyerau kishnayim — pasul, lepi shechesrono nireh venikkar sheeno tam veshalem:

Derek giddul hallulab kak hu: leachar sheyyotze aleh echad mehashshidra, miyyad keshiur shette etzbaot oleh od echad, veken harbeh zeh al gabbe zeh ad shemmitkasseh kullo bealin mitztzad echad, veken mitztzad hashsheni, veim mitztzad echad hu mekusseh kullo bealin vetzad hashsheni hu arom belo alin — pasul, lepi sheeno mehuddar:
Veken im en lo alin harbeh zeh al gabbe zeh, ella mikkol tzad yotze aleh echad lematta samuk leiqqaro veoleh ad rosho — pasul, sheggam zeh eno hiddur:

Veken im hayu lo harbeh alin velo hayu munnachin zeh al gabbe zeh ella zeh tachat zeh, dehaynu shehen meruchaqin zeh lemala mizzeh harbeh beinyan sheen haelyon munnach kelal al gabbe hattachton shellematta mimmennu, im rosh aleh zeh maggia leiqqar aleh zeh shellemala mimmennu ad shennimtza kol hashshidra shel lulab mekussa bealin — kasher, abal im en rosho shel zeh maggia leiqqaro shel zeh — pasul, sheen zeh hiddur:

Lulab sheyyobsha rob shidrato o sheyyabeshu rob alayv — pasul, sheen zeh niqra hiddur. Vekamma shiur yebeshut happosel? Yesh omerim mishshenniprak batztzipporen keshemmemashmeshin bo. Veyesh omerim mishsheyyikleh kol mareh yarqut shebbo vehilbinu panayv — hare hu niqra yabesh, ap al pi sheeno niprak batztzipporen, lepi shezzehu siman shekkala hallachluchit shebbo. Vahalaka kassebara haacharona. Umikkol maqom, bishat haddechaq kegon bimdinot ellu sheen lulabin metzuyin — yesh lismok al sebara harishona (im i epshar limtzo lulab acher, ayyen bet yosep siman trm"t):

Niqtam rosho — pasul, lepi sheen zeh hiddur. Veezehu rosho? Zeh aleh haelyon haemtzai shehu gaboah mikkol healin, veim aleh zeh niqtam berosho apillu kol shehu — pasul. Veyesh omerim sheeno pasul ella im ken niqtam rob orko shel aleh zeh haelyon. Veyesh lehachamir kassebara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bishat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo lulab acher — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona. Umuttar lebarek al lulab shenniqtam miut shel aleh haelyon, abal im niqtam rubbo — en lebarek alayv apillu bishat haddechaq, ella im ken bemaqom shennohagim lebarek al kol happesulin gemurim bishat haddechaq, ukemo sheyyitbaer besiman trm"t, ayyen sham:

Im yesh lo kemin qotzim yotzeim mishshidrato, veken im nitzmat unikvatz, veken im neeqam lepanayv, dehaynu hatztzad shekkeneged hashshidra neeqam venikpap ad shennaaset shidrato kegab baal chatotarot — pasul, sheen zeh hiddur. Veken im neeqam leechad mitztzedadayv — pasul:

Abal im neeqam laachorayv, dehaynu sheshshidrato neeqma venikpepa beemtzaitah letzad panayv — kasher, shezzehu derek beriyyato vahadaro. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshenneeqma venikpepa beemtzaitah, abal im nikpepa berosho keagmon sherosho kapup veshachuach lematta, ben shennikpepa letzad panayv ben shennikpepa letzad achorayv — pasul, sheen zeh hiddur:

Vekol zeh keshehashshidra beatzmah hi kepupa, abal im healin bilbad hen kepupim, apillu nikpap gam healeh haelyon haemtzai — hare zeh kasher, lepi shekken derek harbeh lulabin shealehen hen kepupim. Veyesh poselin im rob ale hallulab hen kepupin berashehen apillu kol shehu. Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem. Abal im hu sheat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo lulab acher — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, umuttar lebarek al lulab zeh apillu im kol alayv hen kepupin. Veken miyyom sheni shel chag vaelak sheen chiyyub netilat lulab bahen middibre tora ella middibre soperim — yesh lehaqel kassebara harishona im i epshar lo limtzo beqal lulab acher. Ayyen siman trm"v:

Vekol zeh keshello nikpepu ella rashe healin venishar haggup gadol mehealin beli kepipa, abal im gup healin nikpepu harbeh meod leemtzaan venireh kemo shennikpap healeh lishnayim — pasul, sheen zeh hiddur kelal:
